title: 引语作文的主题解释
goal: 提取引语表达的中心思想；判断解释与例子是否支持引语。

points.label: 提取引语表达的中心思想
判断解释与例子是否支持引语

sources.title: 大学英语六级（CET-6）：课表
sources.used: 写作部分：引语作文的主题解释；内容范围、知识点与客观题规格。

body.p: 引语的中心是关键词之间的关系。解释时保留引语中的条件、对比或否定，再写成一个可以论证的判断。例子中的行为和结果要体现同一关系。

body.box: Practice becomes useful when mistakes guide the next attempt.

body.p: 这句引语强调根据错误调整练习，不是练得越多越好。例子要写出发现错误和随后的调整。只写长期坚持，例子不完整。

steps.d: 确定句中被强调的行为及其条件。when mistakes guide 表明错误要影响下一次行动。
用直接判断表达引语含义，不只重复关键词。Learning requires correction as well as repetition 保留练习与纠正的关系。
区分必要条件与充分条件。引语用的是 useful，解释时不写成 guarantees success。有帮助不能写成必定成功。
检查例子是否写出同一行为和结果。根据录音纠正发音，能说明反馈的作用。只买录音设备，则说明不了。

cards.title: 关键词与中心论点
rows: Effort: Repeating an attempt matters when each attempt responds to the last mistake.
Effort supports improvement when feedback changes the next action.
重点是调整。努力有帮助，但不保证成功。
Cooperation: A shared task benefits from different skills only when the contributors coordinate their work.
Different abilities become useful through coordinated contributions.
重点是配合，不是人越多越好。
Independent judgment: An opinion deserves acceptance because its reasons withstand examination, not because its supporters are numerous.
Evidence should determine agreement rather than popularity alone.
可以同意多数，前提是核查理由。
条件词
Only when marks a condition; it does not promise a successful outcome in every case.
only when 是必要条件，不写成成功的保证。
否定范围
Not because of popularity rejects one basis for agreement, not agreement itself.
否定的是同意的依据，不是结论本身。

cards.title: 解释与例证
rows: 努力
A learner records a speech, identifies rushed endings, and slows those endings in the next recording.
根据发现的问题调整，支持有效练习。
努力
A learner records the same speech repeatedly but never listens to the recordings.
只有重复，没有依据反馈调整。
合作
An exhibition team agrees on label sizes before different members prepare the text and images.
分工前先统一标准，体现了协调。
合作
An exhibition team adds more designers without checking whether their labels fit the same display.
只增加人数，没有协调各人的工作。
独立判断
A buyer accepts a popular repair recommendation after checking what work the price includes.
结论与多数相同，依据仍来自核查。
独立判断
A buyer rejects the same recommendation solely because it is popular.
因为多数赞成就反对，没有核查理由。

body.box: An opinion should survive a question before it earns agreement.

body.p: survive a question 指观点经得起对理由的追问，不是指回答得快。引语讲的是接受观点的依据，并不要求一有疑问就拒绝。

body.box: A neighborhood committee is choosing a venue for a poetry evening. Most members favor the largest hall. One member asks whether the available seating includes space for the planned circular discussion. After checking the layout, the committee selects a smaller room that fits the activity. The question changes the criterion from size alone to suitability. The example supports examining reasons before agreeing; it does not establish that smaller rooms are always better.

body.p: 例子中的问题针对活动布局，让委员会重新核查选场地的依据。如果只写大厅的建筑历史，就支持不了先检验理由、再表示同意的论点。

cards.title: 干扰项
rows: 只复述引语
Agreement should come after a question, because a question should come first.
只把引语换了说法，没有解释追问的作用。
误解关键词
Survive means the speaker must answer every question immediately.
把经受检验误写成回答速度。
无关举例
The venue has hosted poetry evenings for many years.
场地的历史与检验理由无关。
过度推广
A popular opinion is always incorrect.
独立核查不是一律反对多数。

groups.text: Original quotation: Careful effort involves changing an unsuccessful method, not merely repeating it with greater determination.

options: Determination matters only after a method has already succeeded.
Repeated attempts should continue without examining the method.
Productive persistence includes revising the approach after failure.
An unsuccessful method proves that further effort has no value.
items.why: changing an unsuccessful method 和 not merely repeating 对比了调整方法与单纯重复。第三项 revising the approach after failure 保留了这一对比。

groups.text: Original quotation: People contribute to a shared result when they connect their separate responsibilities. A theatre group divides sound and lighting work between two members.

items.stem: Which continuation best illustrates the quotation?
options: They rehearse the cues together to align sound with lighting.
They count the number of sound and lighting devices separately.
They invite more members without discussing the existing responsibilities.
They describe how sound equipment differs from lighting equipment.
items.why: connect their separate responsibilities 要求两个岗位相互配合。第一项 rehearse the cues together 把声音和灯光对齐，体现了这种联系。

groups.text: Original quotation: Independent thought begins with examining reasons, including reasons offered by familiar voices.

options: Familiar voices should be accepted before their reasons are examined.
Reasons deserve scrutiny even when their source is familiar.
Unfamiliar voices should replace familiar ones in every discussion.
Independent thought requires disagreeing with familiar speakers.
items.why: including reasons offered by familiar voices 说明熟悉的人给出的理由也要核查，即第二项。第四项把核查理由写成了必须反对。

groups.text: Original quotation: A correction improves practice only if it changes a later attempt. A learner notices that a knitted sample is too tight.

items.stem: Which response best supports the quoted claim?
options: The learner unravels the tight sample but does not knit another one.
The learner counts completed samples without comparing their tension.
The learner repeats the same stitches without using the correction.
The learner adjusts the tension and checks the next sample.
items.why: 依据是 changes a later attempt：纠正要改变下一次的做法。第四项调整松紧并检查下一块样品，写出了这一点。第一项拆掉了样品，却没有再织下一块。

groups.text: Original quotation: Cooperation requires agreement about how separate contributions will fit together. A local choir asks one volunteer to arrange the music and another to plan the rehearsal schedule. They work diligently but never compare their plans. The music requires a long rehearsal that the schedule does not provide. Their individual effort is real, yet the combined plan cannot be used as intended. The missing element is coordination, rather than an increase in the number of volunteers.

items.stem: What makes this a useful negative example?
options: It shows that arranging music is less important than scheduling.
It shows that diligent separate work can fail without coordination.
It shows that a choir must recruit more volunteers to rehearse.
It shows that volunteers should exchange all their responsibilities.
items.why: never compare their plans 让两份安排对不上。例子从反面说明 fit together 需要协调，即第二项。

items.tail: of people working independently on the same shared project.
items.why: the need for coordination 是中心条件。rather than an increase 后面接 in the number，说明增加人数代替不了协调。

groups.text: Consider this original quotation: A useful revision begins when a writer examines the reason for a reader's confusion. Discuss the relationship between effort and responsive revision. Explain why producing a longer draft is not necessarily an improvement. Use an example that connects a reader's difficulty with a specific change to a text. The argument should concern how feedback directs effort; it should not become a general account of how many hours writers spend working or a claim that every reader's suggestion must be accepted.

items.stem: Which thesis best interprets the quotation?
options: Longer drafts demonstrate that writers have responded to every reader.
The number of hours spent writing is the best measure of revision.
Every reader's proposed change must be included in a revised draft.
Revision becomes purposeful when it addresses an identified difficulty.
items.why: examines the reason for a reader's confusion 说明修改要先找出读者困惑的原因，再针对它修改，即第四项。第一项把修改写成了篇幅变长。

items.stem: Which example most directly supports this interpretation?
options: A writer clarifies a missing comparison after a reader identifies the gap.
A writer adds a page of background without examining the reader's question.
A writer logs extra working hours while retaining the confusing comparison.
A writer collects several comments but submits the unchanged draft.
items.why: 题目要求 connects a reader's difficulty with a specific change。第一项中读者指出缺少比较，作者随即补清楚，困难和修改一一对应。

items.stem: Express the role of feedback in revision.
items.tail: rather than the additional length of the draft or the number of working hours.
items.why: depends on 作主句谓语，不能用 depending。between … and … 把读者的困难和作者的回应连在一起。

items.tail: the reader instead of merely adding unrelated material to the original draft.
items.why: because the change responds 说明例子为什么相关，从句谓语用 responds。identified by 后面接 the reader。

groups.text: Consider this original quotation: A shared decision is stronger when each participant checks the reasons, even if everyone finally agrees. Discuss independent judgment in group decisions. Explain why agreement and independent thinking can coexist. Use a case in which people examine evidence before reaching a common conclusion. An example in which a participant rejects a proposal simply to appear different would change the meaning. The focus should remain on the basis of judgment, rather than on whether the final vote is unanimous.

items.stem: Which distinction is central to the quotation?
options: Independent thinkers disagree, whereas dependent thinkers reach common decisions.
Independence concerns checking reasons, rather than producing a different vote.
A unanimous vote removes the need to examine the reasons for a decision.
Shared decisions require each participant to use a different set of evidence.
items.why: each participant checks the reasons, even if everyone finally agrees 把判断的依据和最后的投票分开，即第二项。第一项把独立思考写成了投反对票。

items.stem: Which case best illustrates the intended relation?
options: Committee members agree because the first speaker sounds confident.
One participant rejects a repair plan without checking its costs.
Members check repair estimates separately and then endorse the same plan.
Members reach a unanimous decision before reading any repair estimates.
items.why: examine evidence before reaching a common conclusion 对应第三项：成员各自核查报价，再支持同一方案。结论相同，仍是独立判断。

items.stem: State how agreement can coexist with independent judgment.
items.tail: instead of treating a unanimous vote as sufficient evidence that the proposal is sound.
items.why: when each participant examines 说明独立判断的条件。从句要有谓语，所以用 examines，不用 examining。

items.stem: Explain why the repair-estimate example fits.
items.tail: they have examined rather than on the confidence of the first speaker at the meeting.
items.why: because the members base 是完整的原因从句，谓语是 base。on the estimates 说明结论的依据是报价。
